<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
	xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

	<parent>
		<groupId>org.eclipse.nebula</groupId>
		<artifactId>grid</artifactId>
		<version>1.1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
	</parent>

	<artifactId>org.eclipse.nebula.widgets.grid.test</artifactId>
	<version>0.4.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
	<packaging>eclipse-test-plugin</packaging>

	<properties>
		<nebula.grid.viewport.screenshots.screen>false</nebula.grid.viewport.screenshots.screen>
		<nebula.swt.gc.sha256></nebula.swt.gc.sha256>
	</properties>

	<!--
		The other *_Test classes in this bundle (Grid_Test, GridItem_Test,
		GridColumn_Test, GridColumnGroup_Test) date back to ~2010 and have
		been bit-rotting in the IDE-only .launch configuration ever since:
		they target an old SWT/JFace, an old Mockito (1.8.4), and assert
		behaviour that has changed multiple times upstream. Restoring them
		is a worthy effort but orthogonal to the frozen-first-column work
		this bundle was wired into Maven for. Until that stabilisation
		happens, the freeze and visible-range tests are run by default so the
		feature gets real CI protection without lighting up unrelated rot.
	-->
	<build>
		<plugins>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.eclipse.tycho</groupId>
				<artifactId>tycho-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>${tycho-version}</version>
				<configuration>
					<systemProperties>
						<nebula.grid.viewport.screenshots.screen>${nebula.grid.viewport.screenshots.screen}</nebula.grid.viewport.screenshots.screen>
						<nebula.swt.gc.sha256>${nebula.swt.gc.sha256}</nebula.swt.gc.sha256>
					</systemProperties>
					<failIfNoTests>true</failIfNoTests>
					<includes>
						<include>**/GridFixedColumn_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridVisibleRangeSupport_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridViewportCoordinates_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridGCProxy_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridViewportDistillation_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridBlitScroll_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridBodyDefer_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridCheckLanes_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridColumnWindow_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridIssue700_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridModelJobs_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridPinnedRows_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridPrefetch_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridResidency_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridRowPermutation_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridScrollbarSettle_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridSetDataRedraw_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/GridVirtualHeights_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/model/HeapGrowth_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/model/RowBitLanes_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/model/RowGrouping_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/model/RowPermutation_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/model/RowSelection_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/model/RowStateLanes_Test.java</include>
						<include>**/model/SparseMirrorBoundary_Test.java</include>
					</includes>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>
		</plugins>
	</build>

	<profiles>
		<profile>
			<id>full-grid-contracts</id>
			<build>
				<plugins>
					<plugin>
						<groupId>org.eclipse.tycho</groupId>
						<artifactId>tycho-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
						<configuration>
							<includes combine.self="override">
								<include>**/*_Test.java</include>
							</includes>
							<failIfNoTests>true</failIfNoTests>
						</configuration>
					</plugin>
				</plugins>
			</build>
		</profile>
	</profiles>

</project>
